vault-notification.title: Vault 通知与数据刷新（Vault Notification & Data Refresh）
vault-notification.summary: Vault 4 个操作（deposit/withdraw/unstake/claim）的统一 toast 通知 + 数据刷新机制。WS 推送驱动（sodex_deposit/sodex_withdraw/sodex_call_for type=1/2）+ DecompressionStream gzip 自动识别 + 17 query key 统一 invalidate（mutation 3/5/9s 兜底 + WS Success 单次刷）+ 4 set dedupe + 业务专有错误码（CALL_FOR_*→CLAIM_*/UNSTAKE_*/WITHDRAW_REDEEM_*）+ 静默 USER_REJECTED + claim success 不带金额（call_for type=2 inAmount=0 设计）。

coreLogic: useDepositNotice(): App 顶层挂载(App.tsx:138);订阅 WS sodex_deposit/sodex_withdraw/sodex_call_for + 监听 store lastEvent / lastCallForEvent → 弹 toast + invalidateVaultMutationQueries(useDepositNotice.ts:37-176)
notifyVaultDepositCompleted(amount, symbolDisplay): 关闭残留 pending + 弹 success `Deposited X MAG7.ssi into vault`,由 useSubmitVaultDeposit.onSuccess 调用(useDepositNotice.ts:190-196)

notifyVaultWithdrawSuccess(amount, coinSymbol): 关闭 pending + 弹 `Withdraw X.XX coin successfully.` (formatAmount2 ROUND_DOWN 2 位);sMAG7 mutation + WS sodex_call_for type=1 共用(useDepositNotice.ts:215-223)
notifyVaultClaimSuccess(): 无参数,固定文案 `Claimed successfully`(call_for type=2 record inAmount=0/inCoinSymbol=sMAG7 不能直显)(useDepositNotice.ts:234-237)
invalidateVaultMutationQueries(qc, address): 17 个 query key 失效(vault.* 9 + 列表 2 + 全局 4 + wagmi readContracts/readContract 2)(invalidateVaultMutationQueries.ts)
depositNoticeWs.inflateToString: magic-byte 自动识别 1f8b→gzip / 78??→zlib / else→raw deflate,DecompressionStream API 无 pako 依赖(depositNoticeWs.ts:71)
vaultClaimService.catch: CALL_FOR_FAILED→CLAIM_FAILED / CALL_FOR_TIMEOUT→CLAIM_TIMEOUT(vaultClaimService.ts:82-99);unstake/withdraw service 同模式
keyComponents: src/features/trade/containers/useDepositNotice.ts — App 顶层挂载,订阅 WS + 弹 toast + invalidate
src/features/trade/services/depositNoticeDataService.ts — Stream Service refCount 单例,3 个事件订阅
src/features/trade/stores/depositNoticeStore.ts — lastEvent/lastCallForEvent + 4 个 dedupe Set
src/shared/infra/ws/depositNoticeWs.ts — DecompressionStream gzip/zlib/raw deflate 自动识别
src/shared/utils/invalidateVaultMutationQueries.ts — 17 query key 统一失效 helper
src/features/vault/containers/useSubmitVault{Deposit,Withdraw,Unstake,Claim}.ts — 4 个 mutation hook,onSuccess 调 helper + 3 次延迟 invalidate
src/features/vault/containers/handle{Deposit,Withdraw,Unstake,Claim}ServiceError.ts — error.kind → toast 文案映射

wsEventMatrix.dedupe: 标记 success Set 防重弹

invalidateScope.delayPattern: mutation onSuccess: setTimeout 3s/5s/9s; WS sodex_call_for Success: 单次

relatedFeatures: vault-deposit / vault-withdraw / vault-unstake / vault-claim mutation hooks
trade.useSubmitTransfer (smart-transfer 自带 toast)
auth.exchangeAccountId (deposit 完成后首次链上 accountId 检测)
spot.accountUpdate WS (Spot 余额自动刷新)
pitfalls: WS pending autoClose:false 必须由后续 closeNotify 关闭,设计上 sodex_deposit 有两条独立路径(WS Success + vault completion)兜底防永挂
claim success 不能用 inAmount/inCoinSymbol — type=2 record inAmount=0 / inCoinSymbol=sMAG7(call_for 视角),会误导用户领到的 MAG7 数量
mapInfraErrorToServiceError 输出通用 CALL_FOR_*,Service 层 catch 内必须转为业务专有 kind(避免 unstake 流程暴露 CLAIM_TIMEOUT)
wagmi useReadContracts/useReadContract 的 React Query key 不会自动失效,必须 invalidate `["readContracts"]` / `["readContract"]` 前缀刷
服务端可能重复推送 sodex_call_for Success 4+ 次,dedupe 4 个 Set 保证只弹一次
withdraw sMAG7 路径无 WS 推送,mutation onSuccess 必须主动弹 toast — 唯一 vault feature 主动起 success toast 的入口
WS 解压必须按 magic byte 路由(1f8b/78xx/else),老项目 pako auto-detect 兼容,新项目 DecompressionStream 必须显式分支
useDepositNotice 必须在 App 顶层挂载一次(App.tsx:138),不能多组件 mount(refCount 单例保证)

vault-unstake.title: Vault Unstake 完整流程
vault-unstake.summary: Vault SLP 独立 Unstake 入口:用户把 EVM-Funding(或 Spot 兜底)的 sMAG7.ssi 转回 MAG7.ssi 进入 14 天 cooldown。Smart-transfer 在 Container 编排(boundaries 限制) + Service 走 CallForPermit(callForType=1, toClob=false)+ catch 内 CALL_FOR_*→UNSTAKE_* 转换 + signer 锁防钱包切换 + 4.5s 轮询 EVM 余额(500/1000/3000ms)+ onSuccess 不弹 toast(等 WS sodex_call_for type=1)+ 3 次延迟 invalidate(3s/5s/9s)+ 老用户 apiKey 失效独立 Enable Unstake 按钮(embedded mode 不叠 AuthStepsModal)。

coreLogic: useSubmitVaultUnstake(): mutation 编排(onMutate 锁 signer + smart-transfer + executeUnstakePermit + onSuccess 3 次延迟 invalidate + onError 调 handler);返回 { submit, isSubmitting, isAwaitingWalletSignature, error, reset }(useSubmitVaultUnstake.ts:33-162)

executeUnstakePermit(capability, input): Service 5 步链路(getClaimNonce → buildUnstakeCmd/typedData → signCallForPermit → onSigned() → postCallForPermit → waitForClaimReceipt);catch 内 CALL_FOR_FAILED→UNSTAKE_FAILED / CALL_FOR_TIMEOUT→UNSTAKE_TIMEOUT(vaultUnstakeService.ts:42-98)
waitForEvmSmag7Balance({ walletAddress, targetAmount }): 4 次读取 t=0/0.5/1.5/4.5s,readContract balanceOf 精度 8;超时抛 TX_TIMEOUT → service catch 转 EVM_BALANCE_TIMEOUT(vaultUnstakeInfra.ts:37-57)

buildUnstakeCmd(amount): EIP-712 cmd { chain:BASE_ETH, callForType:1, toClob:false, inCoinSymbol:vsMAG7, outCoinSymbol:vMAG7, inAmount:parseUnits(amount,8), minOutAmount:0 };与 claim 差异 callForType=1+toClob=false(unstakePermit.ts:28-38)
useVaultUnstakeForm({ max }): 表单 state + helperText + isValid;最低金额 5 sMAG7.ssi 模块内常量(useVaultUnstakeForm.ts:12-60)
deriveUnstakeButtonState({ amount, min, max, isSubmitting }): 纯函数返回 { isSubmitting, disabled, helperText };与 claimFlowLogic 几乎相同(unstakeFlowLogic.ts:11-26)

handleUnstakeServiceError(error): error.kind→toast 映射(USER_REJECTED 静默 / TRANSFER_FAILED+UNSTAKE_FAILED notify.error / EVM_BALANCE_TIMEOUT+UNSTAKE_TIMEOUT notify.warning / 其他兜底 default)(handleUnstakeServiceError.ts:6-68)
keyComponents: src/features/vault/components/dialogs/VaultUnstakeDialog/index.tsx — UI 主入口 + opener(openVaultUnstakeDialog)
src/features/vault/components/dialogs/VaultUnstakeDialog/VaultUnstakeButton.tsx — 3 态按钮(等签名/提交中/默认)
src/features/vault/containers/useSubmitVaultUnstake.ts — mutation 编排(smart-transfer + CallForPermit)
src/features/vault/containers/useVaultUnstakeForm.ts — 表单 state + helperText + isValid
src/features/vault/services/vaultUnstakeService.ts — executeUnstakePermit(catch CALL_FOR_*→UNSTAKE_*)
src/features/vault/infra/chain/vaultUnstakeInfra.ts — waitForEvmSmag7Balance(4.5s 轮询)
src/features/vault/domain/unstakePermit.ts — EIP-712 typed data + cmd encode
errorKinds: UNSTAKE_TIMEOUT(receipt 等待超时,catch 转换)
uiStates: isAwaitingWalletSignature: vault 自身签名节点(apiKey/unstake permit)等签名中 → 按钮文案 walletAction
state.isSubmitting: 链上等待 / smart-transfer 中 → 按钮 'Submitting...'
needsStandaloneEnable: 老用户 apiKey 失效 → 独立 Enable Unstake 按钮(embedded mode)
isAccountIdProbing: 账户探测中 → 乐观视为老用户防 flash
isWatching: admin 观察其他账户 → 关闭 Enable 分支显示默认 Unstake

callForCmdShape.toClob: false(unstake 进 cooldown,不直达 spot)

writes: 链上 CallForPermit 提交 → 服务端启 14-day cooldown

vault-claim(同样走 CallForPermit,callForType=2/toClob=true,共享 infra/domain)
vault-withdraw(MAG7 路径内嵌 unstake 步骤,共享 sodex_call_for type=1 推送通道)

auth.useEnableTrading(老用户 Enable Unstake 走 embedded mode)
pitfalls: Smart-transfer 必须放 Container,不能在 Service(boundaries 硬规则禁跨 feature service import)
service catch 内 CALL_FOR_*→UNSTAKE_* 转换不能省,否则 unstake 流程会暴露 CLAIM_TIMEOUT 这种语义错位错误
isServiceError 白名单要包含 UNSTAKE_FAILED/UNSTAKE_TIMEOUT,否则 service 内已抛过的错误会被二次 map
address 用 useAuthState() 而非 useAccount() — Privy 邮箱用户的 embedded wallet 不一定立刻进 wagmi
isAccountIdProbing 期间乐观视为老用户(hasAccount = isAccountIdProbing || !!accountId),防 probe 完成时按钮 flash
watch 模式 isWatching=true 时 admin apiKey 与被观察账户不匹配,关闭 Enable Unstake 分支
EVM 余额轮询窗口 4.5s 写在 toast 文案里 — 改 RETRY_INTERVALS 时同步改 handleUnstakeServiceError 文案
VSMAG7_DECIMALS=8 在 infra 内硬编码 — 因为 boundaries 禁 infra import domain;若链上精度改变需同步 domain/constants 与 infra
onSuccess 不弹 toast — 链上 receipt confirm ≠ 真完成,服务端要启 14-day cooldown 才推 sodex_call_for type=1 Success
smart-transfer 阶段是 trade feature 的签名 UX(自带 toast),vault 的 isAwaitingWalletSignature 不覆盖此阶段

vault-claim.title: Vault Claim 完整流程
vault-claim.summary: Vault SLP cooldown 期满后的兑现入口:用户把 cooldown 中的 sMAG7.ssi 凭证兑现为 MAG7.ssi 直达 Spot 账户。无 smart-transfer(cooldown 资产服务端管理)+ Service 走 CallForPermit(callForType=2, toClob=true, inAmount=0/minOutAmount=parseUnits)+ catch 内 CALL_FOR_*→CLAIM_* 转换 + signer 锁 + onSuccess 不弹 toast(等 WS sodex_call_for type=2)+ 3 次延迟 invalidate(3s/5s/9s)+ 老用户 apiKey 失效独立 Enable Claim 按钮(embedded mode)。本 feature 的 vaultClaimInfra/claimPermit 是基础模块,被 unstake/withdraw service 复用。

coreLogic: useSubmitVaultClaim(): 单层 mutation 编排(onMutate 锁 signer + executeClaim + onSuccess 3 次延迟 invalidate + onError 调 handler);返回 { submit, isSubmitting, isAwaitingWalletSignature, error, reset }(useSubmitVaultClaim.ts:30-121)

executeClaim(capability, input): Service 5 步链路(getClaimNonce → buildClaimCmd/typedData → signCallForPermit → onSigned() → postCallForPermit → waitForClaimReceipt);catch 内 CALL_FOR_FAILED→CLAIM_FAILED / CALL_FOR_TIMEOUT→CLAIM_TIMEOUT(vaultClaimService.ts:39-102)

buildClaimCmd(amount): EIP-712 cmd { chain:BASE_ETH, callForType:2, toClob:true, inCoinSymbol:vsMAG7, outCoinSymbol:vMAG7, inAmount:0, minOutAmount:parseUnits(amount,8) };与 unstake 差异 callForType=2+toClob=true+inAmount=0(claimPermit.ts:70-80)
useVaultClaimForm({ max }): 表单 state + helperText + isValid;最低金额 CLAIM_MIN_AMOUNT='4'(domain 常量)(useVaultClaimForm.ts:15-63)
deriveClaimButtonState({ amount, min, max, isSubmitting }): 纯函数返回 { isSubmitting, disabled, helperText };与 unstakeFlowLogic 几乎相同(claimFlowLogic.ts:12-27)
handleClaimServiceError(error): error.kind→toast 映射(USER_REJECTED 静默 / CLAIM_FAILED notify.error / CLAIM_TIMEOUT notify.warning / 其他兜底 default)(handleClaimServiceError.ts:11-73)
vaultClaimInfra: getClaimNonce + signCallForPermit + waitForClaimReceipt(3 confirmations) — 基础设施,被 unstake/withdraw service 复用(vaultClaimInfra.ts)

vault-withdraw.title: Vault Withdraw 完整流程(sMAG7/MAG7 两路分支)
vault-withdraw.summary: Vault SLP 提取入口,用户用 sMAG7.SLP 凭证从 Vault 提取 MAG7.ssi 或 sMAG7.ssi。**两个 token 走完全不同代码分支**:sMAG7 路径单步 executeVaultRedeem(链上即时落账,mutation 主动弹 toast);MAG7 路径串联 executeVaultRedeem + executeUnstakePermit(进 14-day cooldown,等 WS sodex_call_for type=1)。两次签名(SLP ERC20 Permit + outer CallForPermit VaultRedeemWithPermit cmdType key=4)+ Redeem 事件解析 assetsBigInt 作 unstake 输入 + cooldown 二次确认走 Radix Dialog 不走 modalManager + WithdrawPhase 状态机驱动 Progress View 替换表单 + 7 个 share query 数据源(Max/NAV/preview/min/cooldown/cooldownSeconds)。

coreLogic: useSubmitVaultWithdraw(): 两路分支 mutation 编排;mutationFn 内 executeVaultRedeem → if sMAG7 return / else executeUnstakePermit;onSuccess sMAG7 主动弹 toast,MAG7 等 WS;返回 { submit, isSubmitting, isAwaitingWalletSignature, phase, error, reset }(useSubmitVaultWithdraw.ts:41-172)

executeVaultRedeem(capability, input): Service 5 步两次签名(SlpPermit→onSigned()→outer CallForPermit→postCallForPermit→waitAndParseRedeemAssets);onSigned 在第 1 次签完触发推进 phase 'approving'→'redeeming';catch CALL_FOR_FAILED→WITHDRAW_REDEEM_FAILED / TIMEOUT(vaultWithdrawService.ts:45-141)

vault-deposit.summary: vault module **最复杂 feature**(~5870 行,11 个源文件)。3 层 reducer 状态机(top/base/value)+ effect driver 防重入(prevKindRef/unmounted/AbortController)+ 不建 Service 的 Container 直接编排架构 + 11 个 atomic infra + 跨 feature callback 桥接(trade.useSubmitTransfer / auth.waitForAccountReady+ensureExchangeCapability)+ 3 屏切换(idle/preview/trading)+ 双 ref 防 Auto-fill 误报 + RETRY 缓存复用签名 + isNewUser 锁定快照 + enable_trading 两阶段拆分(Phase1 静默 polling + Phase2 单次签名)+ CallForPermit to=SLP_TOKEN_ADDRESS(deposit 唯一与其他操作不同)。

coreLogic: useSubmitVaultDeposit(): 外层编排;持 useVaultDepositMachine(input, callbacks);提供 5 个 callbacks 桥接跨 feature(trade.useSubmitTransfer / auth.waitForAccountReady + ensureExchangeCapability / notifyVaultDepositCompleted / handleDepositServiceError);派生 isAwaitingWalletSignature(approving/confirm_signing);submit/retry/reset/showTryAgain;closeNotify 兜底防 WS pending 残留(useSubmitVaultDeposit.ts:43-291)

useVaultDepositMachine(input, callbacks): 3 个 useReducer(top/base/value)+ 3 个 effect driver + 6 个 useRef 防重入(prev*KindRef/isUnmountedRef/abortRef/resolvedBridgeAddrRef/approveSignatureRef/confirmPayloadRef);runBaseChainState 7 个 case + runValueChainState 7 个 case + runEnableTradingAsync;mapCauseToDepositError 按 state.kind 推断 error.kind(useVaultDepositMachine.ts:122-778)

topReducer/baseChainReducer/valueChainReducer: 3 层纯函数;TopState 6 kind / BaseChainState 9 kind / ValueChainState 9 kind;RETRY 缓存复用规则(Base 保留 approveTxHash 跳到 approve_completed / Value cache.approveSignature+approveDeadline 在 deadline 内复用签名跳到 approve_completed)(depositStateMachine.ts:46/166/362)

useVaultDepositForm({tradingStatus,isNewUser,defaultChain,defaultToken,defaultFrom}): 表单 state + 三路余额查询(Base wagmi useReadContract / Value spot 与 evm BalancesQuery)+ 双 ref 防 Auto-fill 误报(userHasEditedRef/hasUserInputtedRef);切 chain/token/from 自动 reset userHasEdited 触发 auto-fill(useVaultDepositForm.ts:84-323)

validateDepositAmount({amount,balance,minAmount,hasUserInputted,userHasEdited,isBalanceLoading}): 三重校验(空/min/max)+ 错误抑制规则(余额加载中 / hasUserInputted 控制 min 提示 / userHasEdited 控制 'Not enough' 提示);返回 {isValid,canSubmit,errorText?}(depositFlowLogic.ts:330-398)

decideValueChainConfig({chain,from,isStake}): chain=BASE_ETH → {needsTransfer:true,needsStake:false}(force SPOT);VALUE_CHAIN → {needsTransfer: from!=='EVM_FUNDING', needsStake:false};needsStake 恒 false(vault 内部处理 stake)(depositFlowLogic.ts:30-44)

buildVaultDepositCallForPermitTypedData({cmd,to,nonce,deadline,...}): EIP-712 typed data;cmdType=VaultDepositWithPermit2;to=SLP_TOKEN_ADDRESS(**deposit 唯一与其他操作不同**;claim/unstake/withdraw to=VAULT_CALLER_ADDRESS)(depositPermit.ts:147-186)

onEnableTradingCallback: 两阶段拆分;Phase 1 waitForAccountReady 静默 polling 链上 accountId(无 UI);Phase 2 ensureExchangeCapability single call(成功=已签/失败=USER_REJECTED);避免旧设计循环弹签名烦扰用户(useSubmitVaultDeposit.ts:100-143)

handleDepositServiceError(error): error.kind→toast 映射 13 case(USER_REJECTED→error 'Transaction Canceled' / DEPOSIT_*→error/warning by kind / TRANSFER_FAILED/EVM_BALANCE_TIMEOUT 等)(handleDepositServiceError.ts:10-122)
shouldShowDepositTryAgain(error,phase): USER_REJECTED → true / phase==='value_chain' → true / phase==='base_chain' 非拒签 → false(bridge 已上链)(handleDepositServiceError.ts:131-138)

stateModelKey.BaseChainState: idle / checking_allowance / approving / approve_confirming / approve_completed / bridging / bridge_confirming / bridge_settling / completed / failed
stateModelKey.ValueChainState: idle / transferring / staking / stake_confirming / approving / approve_completed / confirm_signing / confirm_proceeding / completed / failed
retryReuseRules: Base step=approve failed → 回 checking_allowance 完整重跑
Base step=confirm failed → 回 approve_completed 复用 approveTxHash 跳过 approve
Value stake failed → 回 staking 不回 transfer
Value approve failed → 回 approving 重签
Value confirm failed + approveDeadline 内 → 回 approve_completed 复用 approveSignature
Value confirm failed + approveDeadline 过期 → 回 approving 重签

writes: Phase 2 ensureExchangeCapability: enable trading 签名

trade.useEvmBalancesQuery / useBalancesQuery(form 余额来源)
trade.notifyVaultDepositCompleted(顶层完成 toast)
auth.waitForAccountReady(enable_trading Phase 1 静默 polling)
auth.ensureExchangeCapability(enable_trading Phase 2 签名)
auth.useEnableTrading(老用户 Enable Deposit 独立按钮)
auth.openConnectWalletDialog(未连钱包入口)
wagmi.useReadContract(Base ERC20 余额) / useChainId / useSwitchChain(切链)
designDecisions: 不建 vault deposit Service - 状态机 + 跨 feature 编排无法塞进单一 Service,Container 直接编排 infra atomic
3 层 reducer 拆分 - top 协调阶段 / base+value 各自管 step,RETRY 复用规则各自独立
enable_trading 两阶段拆分 - Phase 1 静默 polling + Phase 2 单次签名,修复旧设计循环弹签名烦扰用户 bug
signer 锁用 requireOnChain call-time(vs 其他 vault feature onMutate 快照) - reducer 没 mutation context,call-time 仍能感知钱包切换
双 ref 防 Auto-fill 误报 - userHasEdited 阻挡 auto-fill / hasUserInputted 控制提示显示,余额 RQ refetch 不闪烁红字
isNewUser 锁定快照 - currentInput.isNewUser 防 WS 推送后 accountId 变化让 EnableTrading 面板消失
3 屏切换 in 单 dialog(idle/preview/trading) - 不用 3 独立弹窗,关弹窗即清整子树
CallForPermit to=SLP_TOKEN_ADDRESS - deposit 唯一与其他操作不同(其他 to=VAULT_CALLER_ADDRESS)
SoDEX panel 自动折叠 + Vault panel 自动展开 - UX 推进用户视线
completed 后 1s 延迟关闭 - 让用户看完所有绿色完成状态再关弹窗
Privy 邮箱用户用 useAuthState().address 而非 useAccount() - embedded wallet 不一定立刻进 wagmi
infrastructureProvider: 11 个 atomic infra 函数(vaultDepositInfra.ts) - 不被其他 feature 复用(独立链路)
depositPermit.ts EIP-712 类型 - 与 claim/unstake/withdrawPermit 类型对称但互不依赖
depositStateMachine.ts - 仅 deposit feature 使用
